name: DeezNutz404
summary: DN404Reflect._transfer() snapshots the sender and recipient reflection balances, then writes them through two storage references without rejecting from == to. On a self-transfer both references alias the same account, so the recipient credit overwrites the sender debit and inflates the balance; the attacker repeated this before selling the unbacked tokens into the WETH pair.

loss.notes: Gross victim depletion is the exact WETH balance decrease of the DeezNutz/WETH pair 0x1fb4904b26de8c043959201a63b4b23c414251e2, from 59.087960396039603932 WETH immediately before the transaction to 0.442623371324096092 WETH afterward. The 2,000 WETH Balancer flash principal and 1 WETH fee were repaid and do not reduce the pool's loss. CoinGecko's last ETH observation before the transaction values the 58.64533702471550784 WETH at $169,979.60.

ageReset.description: The top-level CREATE installed the direct 10,992-byte DeezNutz runtime containing the defective DN404Reflect transfer path; its runtime hash is unchanged immediately before the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed the successful anchor receipt and call trace, verified target source, commit-pinned reproduction, pair and attacker balances, direct creation transaction, and historical runtime. The trace reaches DeezNutz 0xb57e874082417b66877429481473cf9fcd8e0b8a directly and contains 152 transfer(address,uint256) calls from attack contract 0xd129d8c12f0e7aa51157d9e6cc3f7ece2dc84ecd back to itself. In the deployed DN404Reflect source, fromAddressData and toAddressData alias the same storage when from == to; the final toAddressData.rOwned assignment writes the old balance plus the transfer amount over the preceding debit. The attacker repeatedly sells the inflated balance into pair 0x1fb4904b26de8c043959201a63b4b23c414251e2, whose historical WETH balance falls by exactly 58.64533702471550784. Transaction 0x5246885f11e6ddd6e821342c4da8ddfdcfa50fb8ebc2bb367faaddd6b04e4553 creates the target directly from 0x882ededb3eb6540f86f2e7004f2ae09b3ed8f7be; its 10,992-byte runtime hashes to 0x14bbfaeeabb2a48f6d8a29070d415e4703239b08364f646c53e6ab0a0c31e6ae at both block 19277527 and block 19277802.
